svg.aria-label: Each bound for the permanent written as m to a power, against the width m of the grid
svg.text: How high is the floor? Every bound written as m to a power
A flat line means polynomial. The two claimed floors rise forever, slowly; the 1963 method (the ceiling) leaves the chart near m = 100.
The theorems say 'for some constant c > 0'; here c = 1, so read the shapes, not the heights.
m, the width of the grid (each step to the right is a much bigger grid)
old proven floor, about m²·log m
